phone_source: Amazon customer service number from amazon.com/contact-us, confirmed by the user
objective: Return the coffee grinder from order REPLACE-ORDER-ID because it arrived malfunctioning, and obtain a full refund to the original Visa payment method with return instructions and a confirmation number.

facts.refund_method: full amount to the original Visa ending in REPLACE
facts.unknown: purchase amount and purchase date were not provided

opening: Hello, this is an AI assistant calling on behalf of REPLACE Customer Name about a coffee grinder that arrived malfunctioning. May I record and transcribe this call so I can pass the details back to them?

dialogue.after_recording_consent: Thank you. The customer would like to return the coffee grinder from order REPLACE-ORDER-ID and receive a full refund to the original Visa.
dialogue.account_lookup: The account email is REPLACE@example.com and the order number is REPLACE-ORDER-ID.
dialogue.missing_information: I don't have that detail. Is the order number and account email enough to locate the order?
dialogue.refund_terms: The customer is asking for the full purchase amount refunded to the original Visa. Can you confirm the amount and the timing?
dialogue.return_steps: What are the return instructions and deadline? Is there a prepaid label or drop-off code, and a confirmation number?
dialogue.alternative_offered: The customer asked for a full refund to the original card, so I can't accept credit or a replacement. Could you explain why, or check with a supervisor?
dialogue.close: Thank you. I will pass the confirmation number and next steps to the customer.

allowed_actions: Request a return of this coffee grinder only
Share the customer's name, order number, and account email for lookup
Agree to a full refund to the original Visa
Request confirmation number, refund amount, timing, and return instructions
stop_conditions: The representative needs a one-time code, password, or the account holder on the line
Only a fee, partial refund, store credit, or replacement is available
Recording is declined: continue without retaining audio
The representative requires information that is not in the plan
success_criteria: Representative confirms a return or refund has been approved for the coffee grinder on this order
Representative confirms the refund amount and that it goes to the original Visa
Representative gives return instructions or confirms no physical return is needed, plus a confirmation number
